selection: Six independent permissively licensed tool/library families across Python, JavaScript, Go and Rust; split assigned before Saturn observations.

exclusions.reason: Already selected and exercised against this implementation; unsuitable as primary holdout evidence.

normalization: Only local capture paths are replaced. Timing and counts are retained. Original capture digests are recorded.
limitations: Convenience sample of six public code/tool projects, not a probability sample of developer workloads.
Public source may have appeared in model training.
Four evaluation families limit statistical generalization.
Synthetic missing-value markers, one test-only credential, a controlled Click defect, a Commander edit, and one adversarial Go comment are declared.
Semantic labels require independent human review before freezing.
No claim of comprehensive security coverage; lifecycle expectations remain observational.
Dataset version 0.1.0 has no standalone production service logs or large multilingual documents.
Stored capture replay excludes the original upstream execution time.
A declared Requests super_len defect is captured only after the corresponding unmodified tests pass.
The Ruff capture uses an explicitly isolated E/F ruleset; it is not a claim about the upstream project lint policy.
Near-duplicate screening uses five-token shingle Jaccard at 0.8; it does not establish semantic independence. Shared licence text is excluded.

coverage_decisions.unicode: Real Cyrillic text in the upstream ripgrep guide.
known_gaps: Primary evaluation contains only four project families.
